recurrenceRule.description: RRULE string defining a supported recurrence pattern. RRULE schedules use the scheduler node timezone field for wall-clock interpretation in local-cron and google-cloud-scheduler modes, defaulting to UTC when timezone is omitted; unsupported RRULE shapes are rejected for cross-mode parity. Supported RRULEs are HOURLY, DAILY, and WEEKLY only and must include the explicit BYMINUTE/BYHOUR wall-clock fields required by the scheduler contract.

cron.description: Cron expression for scheduling (e.g. '0 9 * * *'). Use either recurrenceRule or cron, not both. Cron schedules use the timezone field for wall-clock interpretation and default to UTC when timezone is omitted.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name used to interpret cron and supported RRULE schedules in both local-cron and google-cloud-scheduler modes. Defaults to UTC when omitted.

startTime.description: Start time for the schedule (ISO 8601 format)

endTime.description: End time for the schedule (ISO 8601 format)
